content.v: 芭芭雅嘎是东斯拉夫童话中的传奇女巫，鸡脚小屋是她最鲜明的标志之一。在《蕾卡的移动工坊》(REKA)中，玩家将扮演她的学徒蕾卡，走进森林，亲手 建造 一间能陪自己旅行的小屋。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261104/1793773372_187721.png
在不同版本的童话里，芭芭雅嘎有着不同的面貌。她有时威胁来访者，有时为他们设下考验，也可能提供指引与帮助。她的小屋同样古怪：它立在鸡脚上，在一些故事中会应来访者的请求转过身，把门朝向对方。
《蕾卡的移动工坊》是一款融合探索、建造与制作玩法的单人冒险游戏。玩家可以跟随芭芭雅嘎修习巫术，在秋日林地采集材料、回应村民的委托，发现隐藏在森林里的秘密。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261104/1793773372_780667.png
传说里令人好奇的鸡脚小屋，在游戏中也成为可以亲手搭建和布置的家。玩家可以摆放家具、装饰内景，让小屋呈现自己的样子。它会陪伴玩家穿行森林、沼泽与村庄，也是在探索之后可以回来的落脚点。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261104/1793773372_851486.png
免费中文 Demo 可体验故事第一章。《蕾卡的移动工坊》1.0 正式版已于 2026 年 10 月 26 日在 Steam 发售，加入官方简体中文支持，并带来完整故事。
《蕾卡的移动工坊》由 Emberstorm Entertainment 开发，Fireshine Games 与亚洲发行商松竹游戏共同发行。
玩家可前往 Steam 商店页面免费试玩中文 Demo，或购买 1.0 正式版，继续体验蕾卡的完整冒险。
Steam 商店页链接：https://store.steampowered.com/app/1737870/REKA/?l=schinese

迪士尼开发美杜莎起源真人电影 巨石·强森参与制片

content.v: 迪士尼正在推进一部以希腊神话蛇发女妖美杜莎为核心的真人电影。消息称，影片将采用反派起源故事的方向，从反派视角重新解释美杜莎的经历，整体思路类似《黑白魔女库伊拉》。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261108/1794101384_869623.jpg
Michael Montemayor负责开发剧本。他还参与了迪士尼真人版《魔发奇缘》以及尚未上映的《继姐妹》等项目。制片阵容包括巨石强森及其Seven Bucks合作伙伴Dany Garcia和Hiram Garcia，目前没有信息表明巨石强森会在片中出演角色。
影片的具体情节仍处于保密状态。美杜莎最终会被塑造成纯粹的怪物、遭到误解的受害者，还是采用其他改编角度，目前均未确认。
Montemayor参与的真人版《魔发奇缘》已经完成拍摄，计划于2028年3月31日上映。《继姐妹》则是由Akiva Schaffer执导的原创真人《灰姑娘》衍生电影，尚未公布档期。美杜莎电影目前也没有演员名单、开拍时间及上映日期，已经明确的信息仅限于题材、编剧和制片人配置。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261108/1794101384_985228.webp
外媒详细报道：

看来，迪士尼真人版《魔发奇缘》背后的一位创作人员，对涉及魔法头发的故事情有独钟。该片将于2028年上映。《魔发奇缘》的编剧迈克尔·蒙特马约尔还参与了《Court Date》和即将推出的《Stepsisters》，目前正在借鉴《黑白魔女库伊拉》的思路，开发一部反派起源故事。这部以希腊神话中的美杜莎为原型的新片，其具体细节目前仍被严格保密;但我们知道，道恩·强森将与他的七块钱制片公司合作伙伴丹妮·加西亚和海勒姆·加西亚共同担任制片人，不过“巨石”强森是否会参演、又会扮演什么角色，目前尚不清楚。

除非你一辈子都与世隔绝，否则你肯定知道，美杜莎就是那位著名的蛇发女妖戈耳工。她常常以不同的形象出现，有时被描绘成毫无人性的怪物，而近来则更多被视为一名遭到误解的受害者。编剧将让这个项目朝哪个方向发展，任何人都只能猜测。不过，蒙特马约尔在迪士尼颇为抢手，他参与的另一部真人电影《Stepsisters》是一部原创的《灰姑娘》真人衍生片，由阿吉瓦·沙弗执导，将登上大银幕，但上映日期尚未公布。由此看来，对故事进行重新构想同样是他的专长，而他将从什么角度切入这部美杜莎电影，希望会让人感到意外。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261108/1794101384_454510.webp
在真人版《魔发奇缘》电影被曝正在开发近六年后，该片已正式杀青，使项目能够按计划于2028年3月31日上映，并为剪辑、后期制作和营销留下大约一年半的时间。“《魔发奇缘》杀青了！！能够亲眼看到这部电影成为现实，真的梦想成真！我从19岁起就一直在写电影剧本，所以今年能够与迪士尼合作（参与四个项目！！），简直是一个酝酿已久的奇迹。”宣布影片杀青时，这位编剧在Instagram上说道。
从2020年宣布开发，到传出项目已经完成拍摄的消息，这一路走了很久。今年1月，制片方宣布蒂根·克罗夫特和米洛·曼海姆将饰演影片的主角乐佩与弗林·莱德。凯特芮娜·巴尔夫和埃利奥特·科万也被选中饰演乐佩的父母，凯瑟琳·哈恩则加盟出演影片中的反派葛朵妈妈。
至于这个新的美杜莎项目，目前我们对它可能包含的内容知之甚少。不过，蒙特马约尔投入心力创作的任何作品似乎都很有成功潜力，而美杜莎又是一个如此知名且深受喜爱的角色，因此该片已经拥有现成的观众群体——尤其是考虑到迪士尼旗下另一部以希腊神话为基础的系列《波西·杰克逊》拥有庞大的粉丝群体，而该系列也是迪士尼有史以来最成功的真人改编作品之一。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

news.title: 当宣布关闭时，BioWare 的一部纪录片已经在制作中：“随着工作室最近的关闭，这部电影现在是一次意义深远的告别”
news.summary: "The best stories never really end."

content.v: Deadline reports that a Canadian documentary about the history of BioWare was already two years into filming when EA closed the studio. Now, it's becoming a sad goodbye to a legendary developer.

"The BioWare founders are my hometown heroes," the documentary's writer and director Akash Sherman said. "It's a privilege and responsibility to share the journey of underdogs who came together to create deeply beloved storytelling. Their golden era kindled a spark in me and in an entire generation. With the studio's recent closure, the film is now a profound valediction."

The documentary, Massive Effect: The BioWare Story, features interviews with the studio's founders, Ray Muzyka, Greg Zeschuk, and Augustine Yip, as well as developers Casey Hudson, Mark Darrah, David Gaider, Drew Karpyshyn, Aaryn Flynn, Mac Walters, Trent Oster, James Ohlen, and Caroline Livingstone, voice actor Jennifer Hale, former CEO of EA John Riccitello, and vice president of Lucasfilm Games Douglas Reilly.

"When the production team asked for our blessing to tell the BioWare story, we were honored and genuinely moved," Muzyka and Zeschuk said in a statement. "BioWare was never just about the logo or the building. It was about deeply emotionally engaging stories and characters, brought to life by the amazingly talented people on our dev teams, and our excellent production and distribution partners who helped us bring those stories successfully to all corners of the planet, and our passionate fans who defended those worlds, championed them and carried them forward. We're proud this film honors those who made it all possible. The best stories never really end. They live on in our memories and wait for someone to pick them up again."

Massive Effect: The BioWare Story is scheduled for release next year. Meanwhile, composer Sam Hulick has shared a re-scored version of the leaked trailer for Mass Effect Universe as his own way of saying goodbye, though apparently Amazon's Mass Effect TV series is still in the works .

content.v: 《英雄联盟》S16半决赛迎来对决，IG不敌GEN惨遭零封，BLG与T1会师半决赛胜者组争夺决赛资格。
经过三局较量，最终GEN以3:0的比分横扫IG，成功击败对手，率先晋级本届全球总决赛决赛。
随着本场比赛结束，IG遗憾止步四强，无缘本届S16决赛。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261108/1794100773_413196.jpg
回顾此前的八强赛，IG曾以3:1战胜同赛区TES，成功晋级四强。
这是IG时隔2566天再次闯入S赛四强，上一次还要追溯到2019年的S9全球总决赛。
GEN则在八强赛中以3:0横扫北美赛区LYON，随后又以相同比分击败IG，连续两轮淘汰赛均以零封对手的方式晋级，展现出强劲的竞争力。
接下来，GEN将等待另一场半决赛BLG与T1之间的胜者，争夺本届S16全球总决赛冠军。
根据赛事安排，BLG与T1的半决赛将于北京时间11月9日6:00举行，胜者将与GEN会师决赛。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

news.title: Chovy生涯首次决赛！GEN 3比0淘汰iG晋级总决赛
news.summary: S16《英雄联盟》全球总决赛半决赛今日开战，iG以0:3不敌GEN，遗憾止步四强。GEN成功晋级决赛，接下来将迎战BLG与T1之间的胜者。

content.v: S16《英雄联盟》全球总决赛半决赛今日开战，iG以0:3不敌GEN，遗憾止步四强。GEN成功晋级决赛，接下来将迎战BLG与T1之间的胜者。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/08/small_202611080901239235.png
首局比赛，GEN上路在前期连续打出优势，先后完成一换二、一换四。比赛进入中期后，GEN逐步掌控局势，先后拿下多条小龙，并于28分30秒收获龙魂。30分钟，GEN打出二换四并拿下大龙，随后在33分30秒团灭iG，一波结束比赛。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/08/small_202611080901344221.png
第二局，iG前期通过击杀和资源争夺取得一定优势，中路也曾打出一换二。但GEN在21分30秒拿下大龙，随后于23分钟团战中打出三换五，逐渐扭转局势。27分32秒，GEN中路打出一换四，紧接着拿下龙魂，并在28分45秒团战中零换四，直接推进结束比赛，将比分扩大至2:0。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/08/small_202611080901476497.png
第三局，iG前期表现有所起色，上路、下路和中路接连取得击杀，并拿下多条小龙。双方此后陷入拉锯，iG在36分02秒拿下龙魂，随后与GEN打出二换二。然而，GEN在30分钟左右抢下小龙后打出零换三，并拿下大龙。比赛来到39分18秒，GEN再次在中路团战中零换三，随后推进基地，完成3:0横扫。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/08/small_202611080902005459.png
至此，iG结束本届全球总决赛征程，GEN则率先锁定决赛席位，将等待BLG与T1之间的半决赛胜者。

news.title: 《GTA6》实体版内容详解：230GB 有线上功能和内购
news.summary: 外网博主详细分析了《GTA6》PS5实体版的包装盒信息

content.v: 外网博主详细分析了《GTA6》PS5实体版的包装盒信息，列出了背面的完整规格列表。其中最引人注目的是230GB的最低存储要求，以及一个标注为“在线功能”（Online Features）的图标，后者被普遍视为《GTA6》在线模式即将到来的信号。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/08/small_202611080848159759.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/08/small_202611080848168031.png
包装盒上印制的230GB最低空间要求，高于Rockstar此前公布的预载数据。根据官方Newswire，数字版预载于11月10日开启，下载大小根据主机不同最高约为212GB。包装盒上的230GB多出的约18GB，通常被理解为安装过程中所需的额外临时空间，而非下载体积本身。此外，有报道提到Xbox版预估下载量为225.34GB，PS5版约为210GB，各平台之间存在细微差异。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/08/small_202611080848272874.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/08/small_202611080848292832.jpg
“在线功能”图标引发了最多的讨论。考虑到前作的在线模式为Rockstar带来了持续十余年的收入，几乎没有人怀疑《GTA 6》会推出在线模式。但该标签的确切含义目前尚无官方解释。一种解读是，它暗示新一代GTA Online将在游戏发售后不久上线；另一种更保守的可能性是，它仅代表游戏内包含在线购买功能，例如从游戏内直接升级至终极版。
列表还确认了《GTA6》将支持DualSense触觉反馈与自适应扳机，并带有 “PS5 Pro优化” 标签，这暗示在PS5 Pro上可能会有画质或帧率方面的增强。包装盒同时标注了“游戏内购买”，与Take-Two此前确认的商业模式一致。
所有这些分析都建立在一个已经确认的事实之上：《GTA6》的实体包装盒内不包含光盘，仅附有一张一次性下载码。德国零售商店流出的照片中，包装正面清晰印有“Spiel-Downloadcode. Keine Disc enthalten.”（游戏下载码，不含光盘）的字样。

news.title: 如果你放弃大部分规则并用武器级 Game Boy Advance 取而代之，国际象棋会立刻变得更有趣
news.summary: "Pawn Chess" is whatever you want it to be in Rulehouse.

content.v: I have never been particularly good at The Game of Kings, but I do love when an indie developer turns their talents to turning chess into something more funky . Shotgun King stole my heart a few years ago, and now Rulehouse is looking to offer its own spin on the classic.

Weird Weekend is our regular Saturday column where we celebrate PC gaming oddities: peculiar games, strange bits of trivia, forgotten history. Pop back every weekend to find out what Jeremy, Josh, Ted, and Rick have become obsessed with this time, whether it's the canon height of Thief's Garrett or that time someone in the Vatican pirated Football Manager .

In a generous demo covering the first act of the game, Rulehouse presents a Wario Ware spin on things⁠—in multiple ways. Each level introduces at least one new mechanic or modifier you have to keep track of, starting with the basic "pawns only, first one to the other side of the board wins," and ramping up to a simulated prison break where guards are firing on your pieces, and you have to get your king⁠—here the game's protagonist in a prison jumpsuit⁠—to the exit.

The escalation in complexity had me genuinely scratching my head, stumped at how to proceed at a few points. Rulehouse eschews trad chess pieces as much as possible, only introducing bishops and kings by the very end of the demo⁠—and stubbornly insisting on calling knights "cows" along the way.

Instead, you get stuff like "ice pawns" that shatter on taking an opponent's piece, or "poison pawns" that bring down the opponent's piece with them when they're captured. I'm also quite fond of the upside-down pawns that move on a diagonal, and capture pieces directly in front of them.

Not every new piece is represented on each subsequent level, but it feels like Rulehouse is building a library of modifiers and complications to draw from in the final game, like how the enemy variety in a classic-style FPS campaign ramps up as you go on. It impressed me that Rulehouse could tease such novel puzzles out of one of the most studied and "solved" games to ever exist, and if it can sustain this pace of surprise and delight across a full game, I think it will prove a worthwhile puzzler.
Take me back

The biggest surprise of all, though, was its presentation and sense of humor. You need something special and specific to stand out with retro pixel art these days, and Rulehouse nails the sound, look, and vibe of the Game Boy Advance. It's got the vibrant, saturated colors I associate with that special little handheld, and all the UI elements are just a little too big, like they're meant to appear on a much lower-resolution screen.

One of my favorite flourishes is how Rulehouse pairs very crisp and clean bits of pixel art with super bitcrushed and noisy backgrounds, often sourced from real photography. It's a technique that was frequently deployed on the GBA, and in addition to pure nostalgia "hey, remember this?" appeal, it adds a uniquely early aughts surreality to the proceedings, the kind I associate with stuff like Wario Ware or, less intentionally, all those really boo-boo, memory-holed movie tie-ins and ill-advised home console ports to the GBA.

The music, similarly, nails a specific sensibility, a kind of synthy funk I associate with Wario Ware, Earthbound or, more recently, Balatro. Rulehouse is a love letter to the Game Boy Advance from people who thoroughly, obsessively, get the console.

Rulehouse is also genuinely funny. Its narrative bits have a strong rate of Smiles Per Minute™, and that dovetails nicely with the surprise rule changes and offbeat art⁠ to result in something that's just kinda nice⁠. Rulehouse is aiming to launch some time in 2027, and for now, you can wishlist it or check out the demo for yourself on Steam .

content.v: 《罗马野猪（Boars in Rome）》是一款以反乌托邦罗马为舞台的跑酷平台游戏。玩家可以组合奔跑、跳跃、滑行和蹬墙等动作，在采用线性结构的关卡中自行选择前进路线。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261108/1794099713_523710_jpg_r.jpg
游戏的移动设计受到《镜之边缘》和《反恐精英》滑行玩法启发。除基础动作外，玩家还能借助路灯摆荡、翻越低矮障碍，以较为自由的方式穿过场景。每个关卡都有明确终点，但如何抵达终点由玩家决定；不追求动作效率时，也可以单纯跳跃和探索。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261108/1794100169_731980_jpg_r.jpg
故事设定中，地球已经被遗弃。玩家扮演的角色从冷冻状态中醒来，需要探索罗马残迹并了解这里曾经发生的事情。场景将历史建筑、未来主义巨构、机器和重新占据城市的自然环境结合起来，部分区域采用了鲜明的粗野主义视觉风格。
外媒Rock Paper Shotgun认为，第一关的环境风格令人联想到《耻辱》和《半条命2》，并将本作与同样强调跑酷工具组合的《VHOLUME》比较。后者提供较为简洁的工具供玩家钻研，《罗马野猪》则加入了更多动作技巧和表现空间。
游戏尚未公布发售日期，玩家也可先在Steam加入愿望单。目前游戏已通过Steam开放试玩测试报名。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261108/1794100168_977850_jpg_r.jpg
外媒详细报道：

多年前，我做过这样一个梦：我在一座大半沉入水下的威尼斯里跑酷。毫无疑问，这个梦的素材来自我十几岁时投入《刺客信条2》的无数个小时——那时的我本该多花点时间准备GCSE考试。多年过去，这个梦始终萦绕在我的脑海中，主要是因为我一直很想以某种方式重新找回那种感觉，而真正的《刺客信条》并没有完全满足我的愿望。结果就在今天，我浏览社交媒体时偶然发现了《Boars in Rome》：一款受《镜之边缘》和《反恐精英》滑坡机制启发、以反乌托邦版罗马为背景的跑酷平台游戏。
老实说，看到下面这段视频时，我整个人都愣住了。“这不就是我梦里的东西吗！”差不多吧，毕竟背景并不完全一样。游 戏的Steam页面这样介绍 ：
“你已被选中离开地球，开始新的生活。地球已被遗弃，机器仍在运转，大自然则在重新夺回残存的一切。探索罗马的遗迹——历史古迹与未来主义巨型建筑在这里交织——查明你被冻结在时间中时究竟发生了什么。”
《镜之边缘》加上《反恐精英》的滑坡机制，你可以在任何东西上跑酷！在反乌托邦版罗马中流畅而有型地穿行。或者只是随意跳来跳去、四处探索，怎么适合你就怎么来。它叫《Boars in Rome》！

它并非处处都与我的梦境相符。有些场景带有更鲜明的粗野主义风格，而不是人们通常会联想到罗马的那些古老得多的建筑，但那种感觉依然存在。《Boars in Rome》动起来时，也颇有一种梦境般的感觉。玩家对游戏角色身体的掌控程度，远远超过我的真实身体能够做到、或者愿意尝试的程度。你可以奔跑、跳跃、滑行和蹬墙奔跑。从机制上看，它与《VHOLUME》相当接近。两者的区别在于，《Boars in Rome》还加入了更多移动技巧，比如抓住路灯杆摆荡，或翻越低矮的障碍物。
《VHOLUME》更像是给你一套简单的工具，然后任由你把它们发挥到极致。《Boars in Rome》的表现力则稍强一些，我甚至敢把它称作一款沉浸式模拟游戏。供你尽情闯荡的关卡是线性的，也有一个需要抵达的终点，但如何走完这段旅程完全由你决定。考虑到这一点，把它归入沉浸式模拟游戏确实很合适。至少，它的第一关会让人想起维克托·安东诺夫在《耻辱》中的设计——老实说，也会让人想到《半条命2》。

content.v: 自去年发售以来，Switch 2已经证明自己是一台性能强劲的便携式主机，而《塞尔达传说：时之笛》重制版或许正是最能展现其性能的游戏。与1998年首次亮相的N64原版相比，这个 经典 冒险的升级版本看起来更加出色。任天堂充分利用Switch 2的硬件，打造出了这款游戏的终极版本，将富有氛围感的场景设计与充满想象力的角色模型融为一体。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261107/1794058994_602818_jpg_r.jpg
如果你想看看这次画面升级究竟有多惊艳，可以观看下方视频，一览任天堂两个硬件时代中的海拉鲁。视频没有解说，只有画面对比。
在这段视频中，我们使用原版NTSC 1.0 N64卡带录制了游戏画面，卡带运行在开启去模糊功能的Analogue 3D上。市面上虽然有多款任天堂64模拟器，但Analogue 3D通常被认为是其中表现最好的一款。它旨在通过各种效果和滤镜，再现CRT电视的画面质感。
N64版《时之笛》诞生于游戏行业开始拥抱CD-ROM的时代，因此必须以富有创意的方式绕开主机及其卡带系统的限制。限制确实能够催生创造力，而在3D游戏迅速发展的年代，这款作品所呈现的视觉奇观至今仍让人难以忘怀。至于 Switch 2版，画面本身已经足以说明一切：图像清晰，文字锐利，额外加入的视觉效果是令人愉悦的点缀，美术风格则让人联想到吉卜力工作室。

news.title: 迄今为止发布的 bug 最多的 D&D 游戏之一，Pool of Radiance: Ruins of Myth Drannor 又回来了，并且可以再次玩了
news.summary: But did anyone ask for this?

content.v: https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/FohMkJ4yQib5MRDt6QHJ75-1920-80.jpg

"Not since the infamous debut of Daikatana has the release of a single game generated so much incensed indignation from early buyers." Our review of Pool of Radiance: Ruins of Myth Drannor didn't hold back. The 2001 dungeon crawler contained, our review said, "A multitude of outrageous bugs," including ones that corrupted saves, made quest items disappear, and most infamously deleted system files when you uninstalled the game.

SNEG's rerelease, available now on Steam and GOG , doesn't have those issues. It adds widescreen, controller support, adjustable combat speed, tooltips, an action bar, and sharpened visuals. If, like me, you skipped this one back in the day because of its reputation for being a hassle to play—even with the eventual patches and community fixes—now it's smooth and problem-free. I've played the opening hours without a single key item vanishing or save file going corrupt.

Don't get the wrong idea, though. Ruins of Myth Drannor isn't Vampire: The Masquerade – Bloodlines. This isn't an RPG masterpiece held back by its buggy release. It's a simplistic turn-based dungeon crawl that's mostly notable for being a spiritual successor to the first Gold Box D&D game, Pool of Radiance, and for adapting the then-new third edition of D&D's rules.

The 3.0 rules were a huge step forward at the time. Any character could choose any class, and Armor Class went up instead of down—you can't imagine how much of a drag it was explaining to new players that lower AC was better than high AC, and ideally you wanted a negative number. It also formalized the central mechanic of rolling a d20 and adding a number to beat a difficulty score. If you've played 5th edition, you'll recognize a lot of its DNA here.

Which is why it's a shame Ruins of Myth Drannor isn't a complete adaptation of those rules. You can't play a wizard—sorcerer is the only option for arcane casters—or a halfling or a gnome. You choose which class to improve when you advance a level, but don't get to decide where your skill points go or what feats to take. A couple of years later, The Temple of Elemental Evil would adapt the 3.5 rules update much more fully. Ruins of Myth Drannor feels rudimentary by comparison.

It's also not much of a story. Set 10 years after the events of Pool of Radiance, a new magical pool has opened in the ruined elven city of Myth Drannor so the evil sorceress and dracolich on the box art can get up to some shenanigans, and Elminster has sent a party of adventurers in to stop them. There's one fun twist to this otherwise bog-standard plot, and it's that you're not that first party of adventurers. You're the B-team sent as backup, but a magic portal mishap means you arrive too late to save the A-team and have to take on their quest.

Which explains why four level-one nobodies now have to clear out hundreds of orcs and skeletons from samey dungeon rooms. It's a slow-paced slog, especially in Myth Drannor's main halls, earning a drip-feed of experience points and gold coins from zombies and ghouls, hoping an orc doesn't score a crit and drop one of your party members in a single blow.

There are plenty of reasons not to like Ruins of Myth Drannor, but I've been enjoying it in spite of them. It's an undemanding RPG that offers simple pleasures. I get ambushed by skeletons, then realize my cleric is perfectly positioned to hit them all with Turn Undead. I meet a weird slug monster, try talking to him and find out he's friendly. I block doors to protect my sorcerer, while rushing enemy spellcasters before they get their big area-of-effect blast off.
It's junk food D&D, but then I mostly play D&D at a table covered in pizza and beer anyway. Between more demanding games, this is an ideal low-stakes guilty pleasure and I'm glad it's finally back.

news.title: 失踪青少年在我们中间寻求帮助后从涉嫌绑架者手中获救
news.summary: A Utah teenager was rescued from an Oregon man's home after she successfully contacted help from another child

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/07/among-us-1794081958488.png
A Utah teenager was rescued from an Oregon man's home after she successfully contacted help from another child in Among Us .

Authorities saved the 17-year-old November 1, 2026, after receiving a tip relayed by a younger player she met while playing developer Innersloth's hit party mystery game, according to Newsweek . She had allegedly spent more than 500 days held captive by 39-year-old Adam Harmel after he took her across state lines and prevented her from leaving.

The Utah teen was just 15 when she was reported missing in May 2025. Harmel allegedly began contacting her through Snapchat earlier that month before offering to send her money to travel to his home in Oregon. He then made the hours-long drive to her location and lured her into his vehicle, disposing of her phone by throwing it into a river shortly after.

Investigators said Harmel forced the teenager to sleep in a bed with him in his basement, becoming increasingly violent through the 521 days she was held captive. She found her window to escape when the alleged kidnapper granted her access to a phone without cellular data.

Although unable to contact others via traditional means, the device did allow her to use a WiFi connection to play online games. Among Us, which allows players to communicate and was released for mobile devices in 2018, allowed her to get in touch with another child.
After moving the conversation to a different, undisclosed social media app, she then told the other player who she was, revealing that she was actively being held captive at Harmel's home in Oregon.

She shared concern that, after more than 500 days of searching, authorities had stopped looking for her. The other child then alerted their mother to the interaction, with the parent then reaching out to the FBI. A subsequent video call with the missing teenager saw her describe her circumstances to investigators.
She was rescued from Harmel's property later that day. Harmel has since been arrested and charged with transporting the teenager across state lines with the intent to exploit her.

news.title: 亲眼目睹之后，我确信《魔兽世界：永远》的 RP 服务器不需要如此独立，而且作为 MMO 角色扮演领域的资深人士，我这么说
news.summary: I'm kinda just playing chiller PvE, here.

content.v: I've been stuck into World of Warcraft: Forever —at the time of writing, I'm around 15 hours /played (and will likely be 20+ hours by the time you're reading this) on my warrior. I chose the roleplay ruleset because, well, I'm a roleplayer. I've been writing and being cringe in videogames for over 15 years .

RP in WoW is, actually, what got me into writing in the first place. My clear and obvious mastery over the written word was hard-won by being a terribly annoying edgelord death knight, for which I apologise.

I was curious about the implementation of the roleplay ruleset back when it was properly announced—back then, I thought it was great that we're being given our own place, but being completely split off from "normal" ruleset (which I'll be calling PvE for simplicity) didn't seem necessary to me.

Having played in the roleplay ruleset for a little while, my opinion has only been vindicated. Splitting PvE and PvP rulesets does make sense. For instance, a resource node might be easier to gather on PvE, throwing the economic balance of the PvP server out of the window. But beyond technical limitations, a complete, strict divide between RP and PvE just has me scratching my head.

There are things I like about having our own little nook of the Forever servers to putz about on. For starters, the vibes are a lot chiller. I don't want to cast generalisations about players, but I do think roleplayers are just smarter, sexier, have bigger muscles, and will solve climate change.

In seriousness, I do think thinking about your character's place in the world and having a bent towards immersion does make you a chiller person in general. I've experienced vanishingly little toxicity or hostility. The absolute worst instance was a tank getting a little passive-aggressive about mining nodes in my Deadmines run. That's it.

But what I foresaw is bearing out: Nobody is really roleplaying in instanced or group content, and that's because we legitimately never have done so. Most RP takes place either spontaneously out in the open world, or in dedicated hot spots. Even in the most diehard MMO communities, people aren't talking in ye olde English while pushing Vancleef's face in.
There are some people who are always in-character, sure, but that portion of the playerbase is incredibly rare. We're talking a sliver of an already-small population of a videogame, here.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/ahEGtzYgdtscBynSWUZPNn-1920-80.png

As for the strict rules on naming conventions—yeah, I'm seeing a lot more lore-accurate names, but I'm also seeing plenty of joke ones. And if I'm being perfectly honest, these gag names really haven't ever bothered me; people being disruptive or annoying when I'm roleplaying are a massive pain, but if Tsundere Cowbell the paladin wants to watch me write, my immersion isn't shattered.

Overall, I think keeping us on our own server architecture for the most part is the smarter plan, especially given layering would dilute roleplayers so much that RP would be hard to find. However, I don't think there's any real reason to disallow us from jumping to the Normal ruleset servers when we group up with someone from there—or giving us an option to travel between them of our own accord.

Just as we tend to swap between in-character for roleplay and out-of-character for, y'know, playing the videogame—I think most of us would be happy to have the choice as to whether we want to futz about on the roleplay layer or go hang out with our non-theatre kid friends on the PvE ruleset.

Especially given, as time goes on, population might become an issue. Believe it or not, roleplayers still do like to raid and gear up, and if they should be able to migrate on characters they've invested literal dozens of hours into, rather than having to start all over again.

news.title: 《质量效应》演员通过视频庆祝 N7 日，请求粉丝帮助拯救该系列
news.summary: Without BioWare, N7 Day is quieter this year, but that didn't stop the Normandy cast and crew from teaming up

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/17/me1-blogroll-1786972844387.jpg
Without BioWare, N7 Day is quieter this year, but that didn't stop the Normandy cast and crew from teaming up for a video message asking fans to help save Mass Effect.

EA shuttered BioWare , canceled Mass Effect 5 , and put the gaming side of the franchise on an indefinite hold just weeks before the series' annual November 7 holiday, leaving players just as hurt as they were confused. There's not really any official festivities to enjoy this year, but the developers and actors behind the stories and characters fans love still made sure to get together for a special video message.

Organized by the unofficial group known as We are Mass Effect, the two-minute video message features appearances from composer Sam Hulick, Jennifer Hale (Commander Shepard/FemShep), Ash Sroka (Tali'Zorah), Keythe Farley (Thane), Kimberly Brooks (Ashley), Mark Meer (Commander Shepard/MaleShep), Steve Blum (Urdnot Grunt), Brandon Keener (Garrus), and many more. One by one, they each call to "Save Mass Effect" in the wake of BioWare's closure, marking what is only the latest shot to garner attention and, hopefully, give the franchise a shot in the arm.

Today is a very special day for Mass Effect fans. We've worked incredibly hard to bring together most of the original Mass Effect trilogy's voice cast to share a very important message with you. We need to #SaveMassEffect. https://t.co/FOp0qp4wBI

"It started feeling like Shepard recruiting the squad in Mass Effect 2!" We are Mass Effect's Mer told IGN when describing the process to make the video. "We were bringing people on board one by one, and Mark was a huge help in making that happen! It almost felt like we were gathering War Assets. And the most surprising thing is that with every video we received, the actors would thank us.

"We'd get messages saying, 'Thank you for doing this,' or 'Thank you for your work.' We were the ones who felt incredibly grateful to them for taking the time to participate, but they kept turning around and thanking us. That really touched me. Everyone involved, from the people who made these games to the people who brought their characters to life, cares deeply about this universe."

We are Mass Effect and other Mass Effect fans have been busy the last few weeks. After footage and details for the canceled Mass Effect: Universe appeared online just days after EA brought the franchise to a halt, a petition has launched and gained more than 310,000 signatures . A Canadian politician also started a government petition to save BioWare just last week.

As some have called to boycott EA , others have taken their fight straight to the publisher's front door . We are Mass Effect has been a big part of that initiative, with its first and most notable move arriving when it launched a #SaveMassEffect billboard in Times Square . Yesterday, the group drove a mobile billboard around EA headquarters in Redwood City, California . More billboards are live today, including one posted up around the former BioWare offices in Edmonton, Alberta, Canada, with another set to appear around The Game Awards next month. Former project director and executive producer Michael Gamble also sent a message to fans for N7 Day.

🚨 WE ARE IN EDMONTON Today, our mobile billboard is right outside BioWare's former offices. For 30 years, BioWare gave us unforgettable stories and characters. Today, we're standing up for the people who brought them to life. #SaveMassEffect https://t.co/fXa4bemyfE

🚨 WE'RE KICKING OFF N7 DAY WITH ANOTHER BILLBOARD This time, #SaveMassEffect has made its way to Cardiff, Wales, thanks to the incredible @psykit. Another amazing initiative from our community, showing that we're not giving up on Mass Effect and BioWare's legacy. https://t.co/4avNpk18jd

🚨 WE ARE TAKING OVER TEXAS A member of our community, AngryBaby, has put up #SaveMassEffect billboards in the Frisco and Dallas areas of North Texas. It's incredible to see fans taking the initiative and spreading the movement on their own. HOLD THE LINE 🫡 https://t.co/AoJBppCzbV
You all are truly amazing. The love and passion for this…universe…is incredible. Even in worst days, we could always count on you. To all the stories left untold. Happy N7 Day.

"We're still holding on to that hope and fighting for the future of Mass Effect, BioWare, and the people who have dedicated so much of themselves to bringing this universe to life," Mer added. "N7 Day is a reminder of what these games mean to all of us, but also of the people behind them. The impact they've had on this community will never been forgotten, and we will continue celebrating it for as long as we can."

Meanwhile, as the Mass Effect cast and fans on the ground do their best to celebrate N7 Day, other developers have chimed in to share their love for the series on its saddest holiday so far. Owlcat Games, the team behind the upcoming Mass Effect-inspired RPG The Expanse: Osiris Reborn, shared a video celebrating what BioWare and its work over the decades means to them.

"Everybody in Owlcat dreamt about playing Mass Effect 5," studio creative director Alexander Mishulin said. "It's very, very selfish, but we wanted to experience the next chapter in those adventures. Our hearts and minds are with [BioWare], and we really hope they find themselves a new home, different studios that will allow them to make even more worlds, even more experiences, more adventures that we will be amazed at. That will be new beacons for new generations of game developers.
This #N7Day is a sad one for all Mass Effect fans. So we want to reminisce about what Mass Effect and many other BioWare games meant to us and how they inspired us. https://t.co/HKG5XkLA28
"It will be not Mass Effect, but it will be something else, and something beautiful."

BioWare's final years were captured on video and will soon be shared in a new documentary . For more, you can check out IGN's interview with one modder who has rebuilt Mass Effect 3's multiplayer . You can also read about how AI is impacting the modding scene .

news.title: BioWare 可能已经死了，但 Mod 制作者已将《质量效应 3》的多人游戏重建为传奇版
news.summary: When the Mass Effect Legendary Edition came out in 2021, it included the single player campaign of all three o

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/06/masseffect-multiplayermod-interview-blogroll-1793999260678.jpg

When the Mass Effect Legendary Edition came out in 2021, it included the single player campaign of all three original games, along with all the DLC. But while all the story content you could ever want was included, Mass Effect 3's multiplayer mode was conspicuously absent, despite having a dedicated fanbase.

Now, just a few weeks after EA's shutdown of BioWare , a team of modders has successfully ported Mass Effect 3 's multiplayer to the Legendary Edition, with all the graphics and engine improvements that came with that re-release. The mod will be coming out on N7 Day – November 7th – and will be free to play, as long as you already own Mass Effect Legendary Edition.

I also got a chance to sit down with Mgamerz, who runs the ME3Tweaks team that created the mod, to talk about Mass Effect 3, and about the state of modding in 2026. And if you want to download the mod yourself, it's available now on Nexus Mods.
IGN: So, tell me a little bit about the project, and how you got started on basically porting the Mass Effect 3 multiplayer over to the Legendary Edition.

Mgamerz: Yeah, so my dev team, ME3Tweaks, and I run it. We ported Pinnacle Station back in 2021. Crazy effort. I don't know how we got that done in a two-month timeframe. And then we were doing other projects for two years, and then near the end of me working on LE2 Randomizer, which is a randomizer for legendary Mass Effect 2, someone discovered a copy of the Citadel in Mass Effect 2.

There's an area from the wards. I can't remember which game it was, but they found an area of the game that nobody knew about before, and you could load into and you're like, 'Well, this was clearly supposed to be something, and then they just never finished it.' It was a very early prototype. And it was like, 'Man, what if we could port something like that into another level?' And so I made this project called Project Wardle, Ward being the first part of it. (We have a bunch of stupid internal code names.)

And I eventually made it so we could port a Mass Effect 2 level into Mass Effect 3, and we fixed up the cover, because cover is just an unbelievable nightmare. It's very important for enemies to be able to use it. Gameplay's a huge component of why Mass Effect 3 is fun. And we got that working and then I was like, 'Well, man, what if we could port the multiplayer levels?' Because we did it for Pinnacle Station. We ported the old game. But Pinnacle Station is mostly just reused assets from Mass Effect 1.

Like 90% of it was just existing assets that they just reused. But multiplayer was totally different. It's like, yeah, none of this content exists. So the scope of work is just huge. So at the end of 2023, right as we finished LE2 Randomizer, literally on N7 day, I spun up a new Discord.

I invited a couple people and they're like, 'What's this Discord about?' I'm like, 'We're going to do something stupid. We're going to port [Mass Effect 3] Multiplayer.' And those were the first two messages I ever sent. I have some screenshots of it.

And then people were like, 'Yeah, you're joking, right?' And I'm like, 'No.' And then the last three years we've been working on it. It hasn't been constant. Last year I broke my arm, which set us back six to eight months.

But for the first two years, it was tons of prototyping. Within the first month of this project, we actually had multiplayer working. It was a proof of concept. And then we spent the next two years getting audio to port, from a different version of the audio engine because they upgraded it. It's like we got shaders building, which was a total nightmare because BioWare compiled the game with a bunch of sources that don't ship with the game.

And so we had to figure out 'how do we replicate that?' So that took a long time. And then it's like textures. We have a bunch more people that know how to do texture upscaling. The first two years is almost all prototype and then asset generation. We want to make it look good. We're planning stuff out, that kind of stuff. So that's really not how it started.
IGN: So, you basically built from scratch again? Did you take assets from the original Mass Effect 3?

Mgamerz: Oh yeah, the whole thing ports from it. It's not a one-to-one port. We're not just taking Mass Effect 3 multiplayer and dumping it into Legendary Edition and then, 'Hey guys, check out it's multiplayer, [as] you remember it.' Where we took a lot of extra steps, the lighting actually gets re-baked in Unreal Engine 4's light solver.

Essentially what that means is, imagine you have a light bulb in a room and if you wanted to project what the lights would look like, a light beam's going to hit your microphone and it's going to cast a shadow.

And then that light bounces off for you, goes into your closet and it bounces off and illuminates the closet a little bit from the inside. Unreal Engine 3 had a solver and that's how all of the lighting for all the Unreal Engine 3 games worked. But in Unreal Engine 4, they added like, 'Oh, we can do additional light bounces or we found a better statistical way to do light bounces.' And so you get crisper shadow edges or the more soft, like a grate covering on some maps. The light bounces through the grate, and unless you have super high resolution textures, it looks terrible. Mass Effect 3 is full of terrible light maps. If you look at them, you're like, 'Wow, it's just a big stair step of shadows and it looks bad.' And so we spent a lot of time upgrading that kind of stuff.

I modded Mass Effect 3 multiplayer for eight years before Legendary Edition came out, and there's a bunch of stuff I was like, 'Wow, I didn't even realize three of the character classes don't even use the highest-quality mesh.' So it's like BioWare made the Geth Infiltrator, and they made it at a high quality where it has all the polygons and triangles. And then as you get further away from the camera, it gets less triangles, because you can't see as much detail. But BioWare was just like, 'We're just not going to use the highest quality one. We'll ship it in the game, but you'll never see it.' And so it's like, 'Oh, well, we can just turn those on and it's an immediate quality upgrade.'

IGN: Was quality a big reason why you took on this massive undertaking to bring ME3 multiplayer to Legendary Edition? Because if I understand correctly, the servers for the original ME3 multiplayer are still working, for now at least.
Mgamerz: By the time we publish this, I don't know, man. N7HQ's gone, so I wouldn't be surprised if it disappears before.

Actually, the whole reason this project started, I was getting to the end of LE2 Randomizer and I was like, 'Man, I love Mass Effect 3 multiplayer.' I modded tons of stuff into it, and it was really fun.

I went back and I was like, 'I want to make a new one. I want to make a new mod.' I went back to it and I was like, 'These tools,' and I'm totally throwing myself under the bus, 'These tools suck. There's no debug tools. Everything is so immature compared to what we have in Legendary Edition, thanks to what BioWare changed for us.' And so I was like, 'Man, I'd rather just port multiplayer than have to deal with this awful development environment.'

news.title: “我觉得改装已经快要死了”——质量效应 3 多人游戏改装者谈 AI 对场景的影响
news.summary: Over the past few months, there's been a sort of explosion of AI in the modding scene. Whether it's mashup mod

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/29/me3-1793234529955.jpg

Over the past few months, there's been an explosion of AI in the modding scene. Whether it's mashup mods on Twitter or full decompilation done by Claude , AI is everywhere in the mod community, and it could be killing the hobby.

I got a chance to sit down with ME3Tweaks' Mgamerz to talk about his new Mass Effect Legendary Edition ME3 Multiplayer mod, where I asked him about how AI has affected the modding community. While he admits that Claude is very effective at modding games, it's causing an avalanche of low-effort content that's hard to sift through. And, while there has always been a range of quality for mods, the inherent difficulty of getting into a game's files and changing things was a natural filter that's slowly eroding.

Mgamerz told me, "The difficulty of making mods and getting into it filtered out a lot of low-quality stuff. You see this on stuff like the Switch eShop, I've heard. It's full of slop, because there's no quality control and you can just ship whatever, and then users have to dredge through all sorts of stuff like that."

Although typing in a prompt to mod your own copy of a game is one thing, the problems start to appear once you start distributing it on platforms like Nexus Mods, where you have to be mindful about how your mod will interact with other add-ons, otherwise you're likely to just break peoples' games.

Mgamerz laid out that process, telling me, "In the modding community, you have an ecosystem. For example, I have my mod manager, you deploy mods through the mod manager, it runs a bunch of checks on the mods to make sure you're not going to ship something that's just going to break someone's game immediately."

These AI mods can do more than just break other people's mods too — they can also make your game much harder to run if they aren't optimized properly. For example, Mgamerz says, "There's certain knowledge, like you don't put stuff in startup files because it wastes tons of memory. If you stuff everything in there, you boot the game, oh, now the game takes an extra gigabyte of memory for your single mod to work, because you didn't want to do it the proper way."

It's hard to argue with the fact that these AI tools are introducing a whole new generation of gamers to modding, but it's doing so without making them go through the effort of figuring out how to make things effectively. We've already seen major modding communities pull their sites down because of this outbreak of AI modding tools that can take months of someone's hard work and spin it around into a 'working' mod after a couple of Claude prompts. And that might end up becoming the default for people who learn how to code exclusively through AI tools.

When I asked Mgamerz what the pathway for people who want to get into modding these days is, his answer was grim. He told me, "Getting into [modding]? I feel like modding is kind of dying. If you come in and you're like, 'I want to just do this, no AI. I just want to cut my teeth, find the boundaries, break over them, have a difficult, challenging task,' you pretty much have to work in secret now."

"Because if you essentially have an idea and someone else is like, 'Wow, that's a cool idea.' And you're like, 'Well, it's going to take me six months.' And they're like, 'I don't want to wait six months.' They can spend 20 bucks and pump this thing out in a day or two, and it'll probably work, but the user will have no understanding of how."

Mgamerz understands, though, that the prevalence of these AI tools is getting a lot of people interested in modding their favorite games, and that's not a bad thing. He told me, "If you don't release the stuff that you make, I don't see any problem. You made something cool for yourself."

Instead, the problem is that, if you install it without considering how it'll interact with other software, it can really bungle other peoples' projects. "Once you hand this product over to somebody else, share it with the world, suddenly it can become everybody's problem. And from my experience, everyone that vibe codes stuff, two weeks later, they're gone. They're not supporting it. So the people that stick around have to fix and deal with all of it."

Ever since Claude Opus 5.5 released back in September, it feels like the modding scene has been going through a rollercoaster, and it's impossible to know where exactly it's going to land. Whether the world of Nexus Mods and publicly available GitHub forks is going to start to die down like Mgamerz thinks it will is anyone's guess. But one thing's for sure: Once The Elder Scrolls VI: Sentinel drops, modding is going to be a completely different animal than the Skyrim days, if Bethesda's next game is even moddable at all.

news.title: 你在 RPG 游戏中做过的最艰难的选择是什么？
news.summary: Unburden yourself.

content.v: https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/ckZUwfxbakq5yXMJMfSmBW-1920-80.png

Welcome to Dungeon Master , PC Gamer's regular RPG column, where Online Editor Fraser Brown delves into PC gaming's most beloved and enduring genre. Grab a seat in our badly-lit tavern and please ignore the goblin puke.

We love a big RPG dilemma, don't we? Right up until the point where we actually have to make the choice and we stare at our screens for an uncomfortably long time, hoping we'll figure out a way to make a call and not feel absolutely terrible about it later.

For my money, the best—agonising, guilt-inducing—choices are the really personal ones. I love that Mass Effect lets me determine the fate of the galaxy in all these different ways, but it never gives me a reason to care about the rachni, for instance, or the council, so when I have to decide to save them or let them die, it becomes more of an abstract moral choice.

Disco Elysium , then, left me in tatters. It's more personal and intimate than a productive therapy session. There's a card you can read pretty early on, stuck inside a ledger, that opens the wound that Harry worked very hard—by abusing alcohol and drugs—to forget. If you toss it, you never get it back. That was a hard one. Is ignoring it a kind of liberation? Or are you just helping Harry hide from his trauma?

It's effective because it's powerfully relatable. You don't even need to have experienced a cataclysmic breakup to understand Harry in that moment. We've all got shit we'd really love to forget. Self-destructive choices that we made in a heated moment, leaving regret to constantly claw at us.

Relationship drama should be excellent fodder for RPG choices, but that rarely ends up being true. Usually they end up being friction free, but sometimes you'll be walloped with the classic trope of being forced to decide if they live or die—a cheap trick to force us to care about someone, even if they actually suck. Yeah, I'm talking about you, Ash.

That's why Geralt's romantic misadventures are so effective at spitting out challenging conundrums. The best thing about The Witcher 3 's approach is that you can choose not to make a decision. It's so rare for games to recognise that indecision is another choice.

I desperately wanted Geralt to be happy. He deserved it. But I could not figure out the best way to go about giving him his happily ever after. The depths of his feelings for Yennefer nudge you towards making sure they have a life together, but god she's toxic. She regularly makes him feel like shit. Triss actually seems to make him happy, but is that just the safe pick?

So I never made the choice. I told both of them I loved them, and they left me tied to a bed while they went off to get drunk. My inability to make a choice was the worst choice. But it also ended up feeling poignant—Geralt so often gets in the way of his own happiness.
OK, what about you lot? What's the toughest choice I've had to make in an RPG? Let me know in the comments.

news.title: GOG 宣布其 Galaxy 客户端将进行改进，面向 Windows、macOS 和您选择的发行版，桌面 Linux 继续前进
news.summary: I recommend openSUSE Tumbleweed, personally.

content.v: GOG Galaxy—the DRM-free storefront's go at a desktop client and launcher—was always a nice dream that didn't measure up in reality. The pitch was: all your games, from all your PC game storefronts, in one centralised hub, but it never left beta in its 2.0 form and, in general, ran pretty poorly compared to its most obvious competition (Steam).

But that was old GOG. New, independent GOG has big plans for Galaxy. In the storefront's first "GOG Showcase", released Thursday, it announced the launcher would be getting a revamp in 2027, and it's coming to Linux too. "We know this has been a long time coming, but we wanted to do it properly: GOG Galaxy is officially heading to Linux", says the studio.

"At the same time, we’ve reworked the client on Windows and Mac to be simpler, run faster, and give you cleaner ways to view your library. Most importantly, our core promise stays untouched: GOG Galaxy is entirely optional. Your games are yours to download and keep through offline installers, exactly as they’ve always been".
That is to say, you'll still be able to find offline game installers in your GOG library if you want to prep for the digital ownership apocalypse (which, let me be clear, is probably a wise move).

Of course, if you're someone who plays games on Linux (cool people, I believe is the technical term), then you likely already have perhaps several tools which do the GOG Galaxy thing of letting you configure and install games from multiple storefronts: programs like Heroic, Faugus, or Lutris. Still, it'd be good to have a ship-shape Galaxy on multiple platforms, and a store with GOG's stature getting in on Linux is good news for PC gaming in general.

The Linuxification of everything isn't the only bit of news GOG released at its showcase. It also announced GOG Social: "a quiet, tidy hangout for actual game talk", meant to centralise discussion and socialising around "screenshot galleries, videos, and community polls with threaded replies and zero algorithmic noise".

news.title: 《质量效应》作曲家 Sam Hulick 发布了他的 N7 Day 的“重新配乐”预告片，“我告别的方式……至少现在是这样”
news.summary: Hulick also revealed that he was asked by BioWare to score an internal demo for Mass Effect: Universe—but work

content.v: Mass Effect composer Sam Hulick revealed in October that he was 're-scoring' the leaked trailer for Mass Effect: Universe to reflect his own "musical vision" for the game. The original, with an edit of " Quartz " by French 79, is pretty groovy, but now Hulick's work is done and this may not come as much of a surprise but I think I like his version better.
So here we have it—Mass Effect: Universe - Sam Hulick Edit:

I'm not a music critic but I know what I like, and I really like the Mass Effect soundtracks. There's a broadly common sound threaded through all three games (I didn't play Andromeda so I'm just pretending it never happened) but they evolved over the course of the trilogy, too: Hulick told me his music in this trailer is "'a balancing act between paying homage to the original trilogy and exploring new ground", but leans most heavily toward Mass Effect 1 and 3.

"Mass Effect's earliest tracks were more about raw analog synth blended with orchestral elements, but more subdued and 'vibey' for lack of a better word," Hulick said in a recent chat with PC Gamer. "Mass Effect 2 leaned more into orchestral bombast (as with Jack Wall’s forever-famous 'Suicide Mission' ), and Mass Effect 3 combined the best of both worlds, with plenty of epic, fist-pump-into-the-air orchestral moments, as well as sparse, moody synth-forward tracks like the ones I wrote for Mars."

Jack Wall, for the record, was lead composer on the original Mass Effect while Hulick served as co-composer; the Mass Effect 2 soundtrack brought back Wall and Hulick and added Jimmy Hinson and David Kates to the lineup, while Mass Effect 3 featured Hulick plus Sascha Dikiciyan, Christopher Lennertz, Clint Mansell, and Cris Velasco.

"I would've loved to have actual songs (with lyrics) to elevate the more emotional moments in the game, whatever they might've been. Fans loved the ME1 end-credits song by Faunts, so why not bring more of that back?"
Sam Hulick, Mass Effect composer

The passage of time is also a factor in Hulick's approach to new work on Mass Effect. The Citadel DLC for Mass Effect 3 came out in 2013, 13 years ago, and he hasn't been sitting idle since then. "I used to rely on synth presets, but these days I mostly create my own sounds from scratch, since it's faster than scrolling through a list of 1,000 premade sounds," Hulick said. "On top of that, the quality of my music production has definitely improved since 2013! Everything in the trailer re-score should sound more polished, but still feel like it belongs in the Mass Effect universe (no pun intended)."

There are some big stylistic shifts over the course of the trailer, made even more notable by its brevity, which Hulick said are meant to showcase different approaches to ambient, cinematic, and combat music—"paying homage" to the original scores while simultaneously exploring new ground. The fight scene near the end of the teaser, for instance, is where Hulick "let the synthwave side come out," while the rest of the music is more in keeping with the music of the original trilogy.

Hulick also shared his "pipe dream" for the Mass Effect: Universe soundtrack, had he been hired to compose it: "I would've loved to have actual songs (with lyrics) to elevate the more emotional moments in the game, whatever they might've been. Fans loved the ME1 end-credits song by Faunts, so why not bring more of that back and include it in the game?"
I think that's a spectacular idea because he's absolutely correct, we did love that shit. It hits hard —still one of my favorite game tracks ever.

The interesting (and sad) surprise is that all of this isn't entirely a flight of fancy. BioWare had reached out to Hulick about working with the studio on an internal demo for a new Mass Effect: No promises beyond that were made and BioWare was clear that it hadn't begun the process of choosing a composer for the full game, but naturally Hulick said yes to "the amazing opportunity to write and brainstorm with the team on the new musical direction."
Sadly, it never got further than that: Hulick said he was "just starting to build a sonic palette" when he learned, along with the rest of us, that BioWare was being closed.

"Had I been hired to work on Mass Effect Universe, I'd have liked to see the direction lean more toward heavy analog synth while also introducing elements of synthwave. I don't think it would've been 100% synth, though. To remove all orchestral elements from the Mass Effect world feels like it would really hobble some of the more emotional peaks in the narrative," Hulic said.

"That's not to say synthesizer-centric music can't strike people emotionally, of course. But things like solo piano and orchestral arrangements have been part of the soul of Mass Effect's score since day one, and without them, I don't know if the music would feel complete."

In a separate post on his Patreon , Hulick paid tribute to BioWare and the impact Mass Effect had on his career: "BioWare took a chance on a young, unproven composer—an incredible opportunity that wouldn't have happened if Jack Wall hadn't recommended me during their composer search. Working on the first three games helped me not only find my musical voice, but also develop the skills needed to work on major video game projects."

He also repeated the sentiment he expressed on Bluesky when BioWare's shutdown was announced: As bad as it is for gamers, it's much worse for the people who work there. "It goes without saying that while we contractors feel the pain of studios shutting down, no one has been more impacted by this shutdown than the hard-working, kind, talented people at BioWare. Please, if you have connections in the game industry, leverage them to help everyone land on their feet."

Absolutely heartbroken over the end of an era. I hope all the talented and wonderful folks at BioWare land on their feet and keep working on incredible games. 💔 I loved every minute of working with you on the Mass Effect trilogy.

Following the now-confirmed end of Dragon Age in 2025, former BioWare senior writer Sheryl Chee said EA owns the IP, but it can't own the idea: "DA isn't dead because it's yours now ." It's small consolation, especially coming so soon after BioWare's closure, but I think the same has to be said about Mass Effect. We may not get more from EA, but there will always be more from us . Happy N7 Day.

news.title: 《天际》首席设计师表示，托德·霍华德的游戏设计能力在于知道何时让事情变得“简单易懂”
news.summary: Howard is "very good at putting himself in the seat of your typical player" says Bruce Nesmith.

content.v: Todd Howard is one of the most recognisable names in game development, yet despite this, the Bethesda director's overarching thoughts on game design remain something of an enigma. Howard has admitted that he doesn't like talking about his games. As such, we rarely get much insight into his broader design philosophy.

Yet according to Bruce Nesmith, lead designer of Skyrim , Howard certainly has a specific set of skills when it comes to game design. In a wide-ranging interview with The Examined Game , Nesmith discussed his time working with Bethesda. During the chat, Nesmith was asked what it was like working with Howard, and he credited Howard with a knack for seeing things from the player's point of view:

"Part of what Todd has, historically for Skyrim and Fallout 3 and everything, been very good at is putting himself in the seat of your typical player," Nesmith explained. "As a developer, I sit in an ivory tower. It's inescapable … I think more deeply about games, definitely, than your typical player. And he's able to cut through that and see 'Oh yeah, they're looking for a little bit of joy here. Don't get in the way with your math and your complex decision here'".

When working up close with code and the day-to-day design of things, Nesmith pointed out that developers can overcomplicate things. "I would try to make things a little more complex, and he was more than willing to say 'No, no, that's not what the players are going to want. They're going to want something simple and more digestible here.'"

Nesmith clarifies that this isn't Howard's only talent and that he "thinks very deeply about games", while Nesmith himself can also "think from the player['s perspective]. But he says that both designers had a "bias" to see things from a particular direction, and in game development, it's often good to "find other people who have a counterbias to bounce your ideas off of so that you can get the well-rounded opinion."

On this subject, Nesmith cites an example of working with an artist who had an issue with the way The Elder Scrolls' 'detect life' spell worked in Oblivion. "He said, 'Look, this spell is cool. It does this really functional thing, but do you realise it ruins all the art? We take all this care in making these creatures and people and whatnot and making them highly detailed and look really great, and all you see is this smudge when you turn on that spell.'

"Well, in Oblivion it just stayed on for long periods of time. Look what we did in Skyrim. We made it a really expensive-to-maintain spell, so the way to use that spell properly was just keep it on for a second … we listened to what the artists were saying because they had a perspective we hadn't considered before."

This approach of seeing things from the player's perspective has certainly worked for Bethesda in the past. While it may not be everyone's favourite game in the series, Fallout 3 did an excellent job of making the RPG more approachable for players unfamiliar with the workings of oblique CRPGs. I do wonder, however, whether Bethesda took this design philosophy too far by the time Starfield rolled around, as the sci-fi adventure had such a simple roleplaying core that it lacked much of the dynamism and emergence that made the studios' previous RPGs so appealing.

news.title: 美国议员宣布“DEI回来了”！ "大丑鬼"时代卷土重来
news.summary: 近年来DEI理念在西方游戏与影视领域持续引发分歧。

content.v: 编辑观点： 近年来DEI理念在西方游戏与影视领域持续引发分歧。部分作品因刻意调整角色性别、肤色或性取向而被批评偏离原作内核与创作逻辑，玩家对“叠Buff”式植入的反感真实存在，这一情绪并非空穴来风。罗·卡纳在中期选举后公开表态“DEI is back”，客观上强化了这一担忧。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/07/small_202611071504171753.png
政策与舆论风向若再度转向，相关创作压力可能回升，部分厂商或将重新加大政治正确元素的权重。但游戏最终口碑仍取决于叙事完成度、角色塑造与玩法体验本身，而非单一理念标签。强制植入与自然融入之间的边界，才是真正需要厘清的问题。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/07/small_202611071504272777.png

近日，美国众议员罗·卡纳在中期选举后公开表示“DEI is back”，高调宣布多元、公平、包容理念回归。此番表态迅速在游戏社区引发热议，玩家担忧此前有所降温的政治正确元素将重新影响游戏创作，强制调整角色设定与叙事方向的现象可能卷土重来。此前一段时期，部分西方游戏因角色设计争议遭遇玩家抵制，Sweet Baby等DEI咨询机构的收缩也曾被解读为“退潮信号”，而议员的表态让这一议题重新回到风口浪尖。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/07/small_202611071504115099.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/07/small_202611071504346883.png
有玩家直言“DEI回来了，大丑鬼也回来了”，认为部分厂商会借政策风向重新加大政治正确元素的权重；也有人指出“玩家反感的从来不是多元，是硬塞和说教”，认为强制植入与自然融入是两回事；还有玩家从市场角度分析，“之前那些翻车的作品已经证明，玩家会用钱包投票，厂商未必敢再赌”。整体情绪是：对“DEI回归”保持警惕，但并不认为所有多元内容都该被否定。
你认为政确元素会明显回流影响新游吗？评论区聊聊。

纯黑以“迅猛式”无伤攻略闻名，其攻略以操作流畅、流程如电影般一气呵成著称，部分作品甚至要求在极高难度下全程无伤通关。此次《影之刃零》无伤系列，他挑战的是最高难度 “逆天者” ，并采用每期“一镜到底”的方式录制。该难度下敌人攻击更具侵略性，部分Boss会使用专属招式，对反应和背板的要求极高，全程无伤意味着任何一次失误都会让整段录制作废。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/07/small_202611071332589050.png
纯黑在简介中提到，视频并非全收集攻略，但每期开始前会补齐此前遗漏的收集内容，不少玩家一边惊叹于无伤操作的稳定性，一边也承认“逆天者”难度下的Boss节奏变化明显，全程无伤对反应和背板的要求极高。

news.title: 小岛秀夫谍战新作情报曝光！叙事长达八个小时
news.summary: 斯卡斯加德称自己从PS1起玩过每一部《合金装备》，并透露本作约有八小时叙事。

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/07/small_202611071012192158.jpg
据GamingBolt报道，小岛秀夫谍战新作《Physint》主演比尔·斯卡斯加德在乔什·霍维茨的播客节目《Happy Sad Confused》中谈到小岛秀夫，用“先驱”来形容这位制作人，说他不断“驶向未涉足的水域”。
这并非两人第一次被联系在一起。此前小岛秀夫本人曾透露，在这款战术谍战游戏中担纲主角的斯卡斯加德是《合金装备》的“超级粉丝”。斯卡斯加德在播客中回应了这一点，表示自己玩过“每一部”作品。
他进一步解释了自己着迷的原因：小岛创造的神话与宇宙，以及围绕他本人的神秘感与吸引力。在斯卡斯加德看来，小岛是一位“电子游戏作者”，同时精通电影制作与电影语言。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/07/cas_auto/small_0_9339855.jpg
关于《Physint》本身，斯卡斯加德给出的描述是“长达八小时的叙事”，同时“也是一个你游玩的完整宇宙”。他认为这款作品更接近“某种照片级真实且具有互动性的东西”，这也是他称小岛在“发明一种新媒介”的依据。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/07/small_202611071012478948.jpg
报道还提到小岛对斯卡斯加德投入程度的描述：他已经准备好了情节，但斯卡斯加德想尽快知道台词以及角色如何说话，甚至催他先把台词写出来。小岛形容，对方现在就想开始准备，“他就是这么深入地投入一个角色”。
据了解，比尔·斯卡斯加德凭借独特的个人气质，在好莱坞及欧洲影视圈塑造了多个令人印象深刻的角色。其代表作品包括《小丑回魂》《宿劫》《诺斯费拉图》《疾速追杀4》《死侍2》等。
此前，官方已经确认查莉·弗雷泽（Charlee Fraser）、马东锡以及滨边美波加盟《PHYSINT》，未来还将公布更多豪华演员阵容。此外，小岛秀夫还将《PHYSINT》称为自己40多年职业生涯的集大成之作。本作被视为《合金装备》系列精神上的后继作品，此前已经引发了不少玩家期待。

news.title: 手机失控自动购买9台大疆相机 支付宝花呗被盗刷4万
news.summary: 近日，江苏常州新北区孟河派出所处理了一起利用木马远程控制实施的电信诈骗案。

content.v: 近日，江苏常州新北区孟河派出所处理了一起利用木马远程控制实施的电信诈骗案。4市民崔某在全民K歌App收到冒充官方客服的私信，对方称其误开通会员需按指引取消以免扣费。崔某信以为真，下载不明软件后，手机被植入木马并遭远程接管，出现黑屏失控状况。崔某随即借用家属手机报警。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261107_zy_red_164_25/1134.jpg
接警后，民警迅速赶赴现场，拔出手机SIM卡切断通信，并进入安全模式卸载木马软件。经核查，诈骗分子已利用崔某的花呗额度盗刷4万元，购买了9台大疆相机及3颗金豆并发往外省，随后恶意删除账单记录。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261107_zy_red_164_25/1234.jpg
办案民警恢复交易数据后，向电商平台提交材料，成功追回2万元。
同时，警方联动厦门警方及物流平台，紧急拦截了剩余的涉案包裹。经过数日协调，包含相机和金豆的12件快递全部被成功拦截，并返还给崔某。
警方提醒，社交平台私信中的“客服”可信度极低，凡以扣费、账户异常为由诱导下载非官方App的行为均为诈骗。若发现手机遭远程操控，应立即断网、拔卡并拨打110报警。

news.title: 《文明7》竟能破解NS2！厂商正紧急召回实体版
news.summary: 据报道，该漏洞可经外接USB设备输入代码，数字版不受影响。

content.v: 过去一周，Switch 2破解社区讨论最多的游戏之一，是2025年6月发售的《文明7》。据Kotaku报道，这款策略游戏原版Switch移植版的实体卡带中带有一个未修复的漏洞，破解者正利用它向Switch 2主机输入代码。
报道称，这一漏洞与游戏内聊天功能相关，用户可通过连接手机等USB设备激活代码，进而打开Switch 2的破解入口。相关讨论集中在Switch 2破解社区，有人晒出自己网购的新卡带照片，也有人交流新的使用方式。报道将这条路径追溯到黑客兼模组作者Gezine制作的漏洞利用工具CivSwitch。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/07/cas_auto/small_0_9339608.jpg
需要说明的是，该漏洞目前并不能用于运行导出的Switch 2游戏。它提供的是存档访问权限，并让用户能够修改游戏、运行自制程序。报道同时提到，Switch 2的破解与模组开发眼下推进很快，部分原因与AI辅助编程工具普及有关。
据悉，2K已开始召回《文明7》的实体版本，有用户表示自己的订单被取消；至少一位Reddit用户贴出亚马逊的通知译文，将取消原因归于2K的要求，亚马逊给出的说法是“技术和安全相关要求”。报道还提到，有人猜测此举是否由任天堂推动，也有人称被提供了盒装下载码版本作为替代。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/07/cas_auto/small_0_9339609.jpg
对普通玩家来说，最直接的关注点是数字版是否受影响。按Kotaku的说法，该漏洞不适用于数字版，因此盒装下载码的替代方案对想破解主机的人帮助有限。至于召回是否属实、覆盖哪些地区与渠道，报道称Kotaku已联系2K求证，目前尚无官方回应，任天堂方面也未就此表态。

news.title: 妻子偷拍丈夫出轨80余次构成侵权 离婚时不予采纳
news.summary: 在家中安装监控的三个多月里，吴女士称，摄像头记录下不同女性登门80余次

content.v: 据大河报报道，在家中安装监控的三个多月里，吴女士称，摄像头记录下不同女性登门80余次，以及她们与丈夫搂抱、亲吻等画面。丈夫何磊（化名）则解释称，这些女性是上门提供按摩服务。吴女士在离婚诉讼中提交了监控视频、纸质素材整理材料及视频截图，试图证明丈夫存在婚姻过错。
一审法院没有采信这些材料。法院认为，视频的取得方式严重侵害他人合法权益，且严重违背公序良俗，不具备证据资格，因而未将其作为认定何磊存在婚姻过错的依据。这起发生在福建厦门的案件，近日引发热议。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261107_zy_red_164_24/1230.jpg
吴女士不服一审判决，已提起上诉，据悉，二审将于11月下旬开庭。
吴女士自行整理了一份表格，标注了当时58岁的何磊在60多天里，与数十名女子见面的时间、是否发生性行为、疑似有金钱交易等情况。她说，这些亲密行为有的发生在卧室，有的则在客厅。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261107_zy_red_164_24/1352.jpg
判决书援引民法典关于隐私权的规定，以及《最高人民法院关于适用〈中华人民共和国民事诉讼法〉的解释》第一百零六条。该条规定，以严重侵害他人合法权益、违反法律禁止性规定或者严重违背公序良俗的方法形成或者获取的证据，不得作为认定案件事实的根据。
法院认为，夫妻关系并不意味着一方的隐私权可以被概括性剥夺或限制。吴女士希望了解丈夫的生活情况，虽有其主张的目的，但取证方式仍须符合法律规定和公序良俗，并遵循比例原则。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261107_zy_red_164_24/1558.jpg
判决书指出，吴女士在卧室电视线路插口处隐蔽安装摄像头，对丈夫在卧室的起居行为进行全天候、无差别录制。这种主动、刻意、秘密性的拍摄和窥视，与其所称的“担心丈夫再次受伤”的目的明显不符，已构成对他人合法权益的严重侵害，并严重违背公序良俗。

news.title: 吴奇隆帮网红蜘蛛猴剥葡萄被踩头 动物园回应

content.v: 据潇湘晨报报道，近日，上海野生动物园。蜘蛛猴 “豆豆” 此前就因为总爱“挑衅”饲养员出圈，这次又闹出有趣一幕，直接踩上了吴奇隆的脑袋。

news.title: 《时之笛RE》M站媒体/玩家双榜登顶！口碑杀疯了
news.summary: 截至11月7日，《时之笛RE》在M站的玩家评分也创新高，771名玩家打出了均分9.7（满分10）的高分。至此，《时之笛RE》达成登顶2026年M…

content.v: 此前我们 曾报道 ，截至11月7日，《时之笛RE》在90家媒体中有48家媒体打出满分，均分96分，成为M站2026年媒体评分榜榜首。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/07/small_202611072123129697.jpg
此外，截至11月7日，《时之笛RE》在M站的玩家评分也创新高，771名玩家打出了均分9.7（满分10）的高分。至此，《时之笛RE》达成登顶2026年M站媒体/玩家评分榜双榜榜首的成就。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/07/small_202611072123565437.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/07/small_202611072121169649.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/07/small_202611072121169663.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/07/small_202611072121163124.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/07/small_202611072121205053.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/07/small_202611072121207808.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/07/small_202611072126129853.jpg
从媒体评测到玩家口碑，《时之笛RE》都交出了一份相当亮眼的成绩单。对于一款经典作品的重制版而言，能够同时获得专业媒体和玩家群体的高度认可并不容易，也足以看出本作在品质和情怀还原方面得到了广泛肯定。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/07/small_202611072126063100.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/07/small_202611072126377442.jpg
值得一提的是，原版《塞尔达传说：时之笛》本身就是游戏史上评价极高的经典作品，M站评分高达99分，仅差1分满分，此次重制版能够再次取得如此出色的成绩，也让不少老玩家感到欣慰。

news.title: 《上古卷轴6：哨兵》是否由Xbox主机独占仍未确定
news.summary: 《上古卷轴VI：哨兵》是否会成为Xbox主机独占作品，目前仍无明确结论。Bethesda负责人Todd Howard表示，现在评论本作的平台安排“为时过早”，既未确认Xbox独占，也没有排除未来登陆PlayStation

content.v: 《上古卷轴VI：哨兵》是否会成为Xbox主机独占作品，目前仍无明确结论。Bethesda负责人Todd Howard表示，现在评论本作的平台安排“为时过早”，既未确认Xbox独占，也没有排除未来登陆PlayStation的可能。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261102/1793600868_843319_jpg_r.jpg
Bethesda终于公布了《 上古卷轴6 ：哨兵》——至少公布了副标题。不过，围绕这款即将推出的角色扮演游戏，仍有一个重大问题：它会是Xbox独占游戏吗?这款游戏最初于2018年公布，粉丝们等待了八年多，才等来又一次实质性更新。如今，Bethesda已确认，《上古卷轴6：哨兵》将以红卫人的故乡落锤省为舞台。

自微软收购Bethesda以来，《上古卷轴6：哨兵》是否会成为独占游戏，一直备受关注。当时，Xbox高度重视独占游戏，但此后其策略已发生了相当大的变化。《极限竞速：地平线》和《光环》等游戏已经登陆PlayStation，这表明，即使是微软旗下规模最大的系列，也未必会一直保持独占。不过，Xbox新任首席执行官阿莎·夏尔马更加重视独占游戏，例如《战争机器：事变日》。因此，《哨兵》最终是否会登陆PlayStation，还是继续作为Xbox主机独占游戏，仍存在一些不确定性。
Bethesda负责人托德·霍华德回应了这一问题，但并未给出多少明确信息。在接受Windows Central采访时，霍华德被问及《上古卷轴6》是否会由Xbox独占。他只是回答说，“现在评论还为时过早”。这意味着，游戏仍有登陆PlayStation的可能。目前，Xbox和PlayStation玩家只能继续等待更明确的答案。

至于《上古卷轴6：哨兵》本身，Bethesda于11月3日公布了游戏名称，并确认舞台设在落锤省，终于带来了比最初预告片更实质性的内容。不过，开发商已经明确表示，更多细节还要过一段时间才会公布。玩家已经知道，这款游戏目前是Bethesda的首要开发项目，并将使用CreationEngine3开发，也就是该公司游戏引擎的下一个重大版本。至于游戏的玩法、故事、开放世界，以及它将如何延续《天际》的巨大成功，仍有大量信息尚未揭晓。
与此同时，《辐射5》是另一款面临Xbox独占问题的Bethesda重要作品。下一部《辐射》正统作品仍处于前期制作阶段，Bethesda目前优先将资源投入《上古卷轴6：哨兵》。霍华德同样拒绝确认《辐射5》是否会成为独占游戏，这表明两款游戏的平台安排目前都尚未明确。Bethesda还有多个其他《辐射》项目正在开发，包括《辐射3》和《辐射：新维加斯》的复刻版，以及另一个有黑曜石娱乐参与的项目。
考虑到Bethesda的开放世界角色扮演游戏曾在多个平台上取得巨大成功，围绕《上古卷轴6：哨兵》的这种不确定性尤其耐人寻味。《天际》的销量已超过6500万份，《辐射4》的销量也已突破3500万份。当然，这些数字并不能保证微软会在PlayStation上发行《上古卷轴6：哨兵》，尤其是在Xbox正调整独占策略之际。不过，Bethesda的说法也没有排除任何可能性。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

news.title: 吵了一周的《影之刃零》最强轮椅，给大伙都整乐了
news.summary: 这是《影之刃零》社区公认九把最弱势的武器，你敢和它们对视三秒吗？

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2022/10/21/small_202210211829418927.png
这是《影之刃零》社区公认九把最弱势的武器，你敢和它们对视三秒吗？
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261107_lcx_581_1/1290.jpg
对于某些人而言，右下角真不一定是缺点
据游民野史记载，《影之刃零》当年的武林惨案，其实并非由“杀气钟”这玩意儿引发。而是某次大伙聚在一块闲聊时，不知谁喊了一句“xx轮椅最牛逼”，引发一众争执，众高手吵上头之后杀气沸腾引发厮杀，最终酿成武林悲剧，血流成河。
是的，《影之刃零》发售也有一周多的时间了，但在这段时间里，玩家社区间出现最多也最乐的论调，不是游戏到底好不好玩、剧情o不ok，而是一种莫名的争吵——
“兄弟们，到底哪把武器是轮椅？”
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261107_lcx_581_1/11037.jpg
谁是轮椅？
在游戏里找轮椅，一直是当代玩家的良好习惯。
这种思路古已有之，后来在《艾尔登法环》中发扬光大，在相对高难度尤其是某些魂游（哎又是类魂）里，好的武器总能让人少走不少弯路，享受纯粹数值摩擦大脑头皮的快感。
那么问题来了，《影之刃零》这三十把主武器、二十五把影之武装，加上一大堆乱七八糟的饰品，其中到底哪个是轮椅？
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261107_lcx_581_1/11457.jpg
如果这两天你逛了社区，就会发现这个答案无限接近于all。
从第一章开始，轮椅的名额就已经出现，能出血的斩钢刀算是个轮椅；当玩家不知第几次被新娘阿花砍断、切开、剁碎后，人们惊呼她掉落的那把大砍刀亦是好用的轮椅：一刀一世界一花一蹦跶（？），石蒜花爆炸削减杀气的样子甚是美味；
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261107_lcx_581_1/11853.jpg
当在血色森林里击败法外狂徒京爷（？）时，玩家发现原来斩马刀才是前中期真正的轮椅，平A自带回血不说，一个Q键自带强吸附大额回血，还是个投技，堪称绝对的不讲道理。
https://imggif.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/07/origin_202611072117113925.gif
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261107_lcx_581_1/12196.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261107_lcx_581_1/12454.jpg
第三章打到一半，人们发现毕远掌门所遗的天玄青铜剑当真重剑无峰大巧不公，在防御端有着极为稳定的数值，虽然不能精防（骗你的，后来也能了）但也不失为一种轮椅；
而第三章打完之后，玩家发现沐小葵给的那把乱莺剑是当之无愧的轮椅，刃身轻巧却可缭乱长空，鸣剑状态下的高速旋转追击上debuff导致输出高的一比；这还没完，她手底下那个把高跟鞋当剑用的玉妖也不遑多让，白提供俩饭盒不说。伤害亦是夸张，妖锯一开就开始原地发狂。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261107_lcx_581_1/12925.jpg
到了庞镇，在破军大人登场之后，我终于意识到这玩意冲起来的无脑程度，以至于在庞镇用了一次之后就把这玩意儿封印了——他就像是ow里的莱因哈特，一波英勇冲锋能把所有韧性不高的人形怪物和BOSS顶到亲妈都不认得，宛如泥头车一般毫无随从（？）交互。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261107_lcx_581_1/13304.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261107_lcx_581_1/13563.jpg
骗你的，游戏里真有泥头车
还有人说，后面拿到的关刀才是一绝，尤其是那一式处决，简直是真正意义上的豪情在天。
https://imggif.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/07/origin_202611072118589461.gif
一时间，各路“兄弟们发现新轮椅了”的调侃，被做成了合集。
不好意思放错了，是这张。
虽说文无第一武无第二，可是，这么多把武器，到底谁才是最吊的？
坊间有人开了个投票，共计一万多人参与，试图决出最轮椅的武器，但其中光是有提名的武器就有整整二十把。
答案是，人人都觉得自己的流派最屌，人人都有点看家本领。哪怕是公认出伤最刮痧的木剑，都有着精防减双倍杀气值的绝活儿。
你会发现，在这些讨论之间，冥冥中竟然构成了一个真的赛博武林。各大高手都聚集在自己门派之中修炼独门武学，只恨不能亲自上阵pvp一番一决高下。
虽然大伙个个身怀绝技，但在其中我还是要点名批评一位轮椅：子母鸳鸯钺（天煞双钺）。
这位本身强度极高，但架不住其持有者有着意外坠崖的黑历史，已经做成赛博琥珀被广泛传阅，引为大众笑柄。凡是有这把武器出没的地方，都有好心人提醒——悬崖边上记得别按f。
鉴于各路武器实在是都好用，无非是多流口水和少流口水的区别，渐渐的，大家争论方向开始往两个诡异的方向走：
其一，讨论范围从轮椅更进一步，探讨究竟哪个轮椅才配得上“担架”之名。
啥叫担架？上去躺着，自己动，光流口水就行。
其二，开辟新战场，探讨究竟哪个影之武装才是同类中的实战轮椅。
是雷枪？是拳套？是金瓜or招魂铃铛？还是血滴子、飞刀、琵琶或者扇子？
——停，别说了。再说我真要敲钟了。
据另一野史记载，《影之刃零》一共开发了五年，其中梁其伟请教了魂大人4年零11个月，最后一个月魂大人没忍住，亲自上手了。
要我说，游戏里最轮椅的其实不完全在武器本身，而是饰品所加的离谱数值，和主角本身就严重超模性能。
自从第三章可以给饰品升级之后，《影之刃零》里那些一大票加数值的小玩意儿就开始左脚踩右脚起飞，当你在陆家村第一次拿到慈母护符再升个一级之后，这游戏实际上已经进入简单模式——哪怕我本人全程用逆天者难度推图也是感觉如此，除了打庞镇女鬼这种相对粪一点的怪之外，其余都是感慨“好爽好爽”以及“不够难不够难”。
进入庞镇之后，许多人死在单个boss手底下的次数，有时候还不如摔死或者被小怪围殴时的意外死亡次数多。
所谓轮椅斗争背后，其实导向了一个很简单也很爽的事实：
《影之刃零》主角性能太高、玩起来太爽了，爽到已经让人在现实中已经念念不忘。

在gameplay上，《影之刃零》选择了极致的扬长避短，它删除了大量市面上常见的恶意设计、也删除了大量垃圾时间，似乎有意去强化主角的爽感和玩家的沉浸感：当玩家们进游戏之后，会发现——我去，死了不掉魂坐火不刷怪，那些活着的怪竟然还能起到助我探路的作用；我去，上楼梯竟然不是当王八慢慢爬而是直接飞上去甚至还能绕个弯（参考《剑星》）；我去，boss过阶段死后竟然不重制；我去，boss竟然躲不过我的快慢刀，到底谁是boss？
这种有效删减就会导向一个结果：在同样的时间内里，《影之刃零》里的战斗密度和信息输出密度，要高于目前市面上一大票动作游戏；而同时，玩家深度沉浸（心流）时间，也要更长——如果你有在第三章末尾是一次性过了沐小葵三连战，就会理解这种心流下的正反馈爽感会有多么夸张。
影境嘛，越玩越爽也正常。
其实纵观这一周来玩家社区的论调，你会发现个很有意思的过程：
最开始，当大部队被卡在新娘阿花时，玩家试图开始讲梁其伟小时候的小故事——然而随着流程推进，这些小故事并没有像“宫崎英高小时候”一样得到极广泛传播，反而是“魂大人”的恩情b王小故事开始异军突起成为主流。
就连玩家社区里对主角称呼的主流，都和游戏里组织的成员一样，像模像样叫起了“魂大人”。
我们在第一章受的苦，其实只是因为魂大人嘴唇发紫、心脏不舒服还跑不过鬼差；序章里选的毒心，是因为魂大人惊讶原来这世界上能有玩意儿竟然能毒死自己；许多npc和魂大人聊完天就死，是因为魂大人的对话和处决键是同一个按键。
没过几天，有关魂大人的诸多事实，从十五个扩展到了如今的一百个。而魂大人逐渐也多了一个外号：
魂天帝。
当然，这种持续性的心流和爽感，也导致了一个有点让人难绷后果：
现实里一大批玩家已经玩魔了，他们似乎都像是历经杀气改造之后……“发狂”了。

news.title: 高达集结：机动战士高达的模型桌面游戏上手体验
news.summary: Get a closer look at the Gundam Assemble Starter Set.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/06/gundamaoo-1793929453718.jpg

The storied Mobile Suit Gundam series makes another venture into the tabletop world with Gundam Assemble, a new miniatures game experience. In fact, this new game was revealed alongside the Gundam Card Game as a visual companion, so fans got hit with a fun one-two punch of new game teases. Gundam Assemble is available for the first time this fall, with more expansion packs and sets already prepared to release into early next year. After a good chunk of time with the starter set, this game is shaping up to be a fun bite-size brawl compared to some of the other miniature games out there right now.

Arguably one of the biggest barriers of entry to miniature wargames is the building and painting aspect. If building is your biggest concern, have no fear with Gundam Assemble. Just like the gunpla that the series is known for, Gundam Assemble features pieces that you cut out and snap into place. Granted, the pieces are a lot smaller in comparison to regular gunpla, but it’s simplified, needing only a handful of parts to complete a mini Gundam unit. I suggest using proper cutting tools since these are miniatures and there’s less room for error. They look good though, showcasing a decent amount of detail for miniature versions of what fans are familiar with. Like other modern miniatures, assembly has been made a lot easier by simply snapping parts together as instructed, but it loses the customization that players may prefer with particular sets of miniature games. Instead, we see different variants or poses of Gundam units across the different releases. For instance, the RX-78-2 Gundam in the starter set features a beam saber attack, but the variant in the Paint Pack has the mech unit brandishing a beam rifle. Although not ideal for those that want a little bit of personal touch to their creations, it does make it easier for beginners (or even impatient players like myself) to jump right into painting and the gameplay soon after.

Painting miniatures is not for the faint of heart, and Gundam Assemble isn’t any easier with all the tiny details, from the weapons to the mech head pieces. And if you’re a perfectionist, you’ll be spending more time painting than even playing the game. With that said, the mech units in the Gundam universe are fairly straightforward to paint with the mostly monochrome looks with embellishments littered about. Thankfully, there’s no skin or flesh color to deal with while painting Gundam units, which can be difficult to do properly. As long as you start off with a primer, you can save a bit of time, especially with units like the RX-78-2 or the Wing Gundam Zero. For me, I like to keep painting fairly simple because I just don’t have as much free time nowadays. And I care more about the gameplay than the arts and crafts of it all anyway. With that said, I do still want to make things look somewhat cool and clean compared to what I did as a 12-year-old painting Black Templar Space Marines because it was one of the easier chapters to paint. On the flip side, I’d prefer to skip painting altogether if possible, and that’s how I got into other miniature games like HeroClix and Star Wars X-Wing – where the minis were already painted. You can also just not paint the minis, but the extra effort does make for a better experience. The starter set even has a painting guide section in its instruction manual if you’re new to the hobby. Other than having some specific paints available like the Gundam Assemble Paint Pack, it’s also fine to use any water-based acrylic model paint and mix colors as need be. That’s how Char’s Zaku’s colors turned out when some friends and I had a dedicated paint day for some of these minis. Overall, painting is much easier now and it saves a ton of time if you do a bit of research before getting started.

As I mentioned, I care mostly about the gameplay when it comes to miniature games, and Gundam Assemble’s matches are surprisingly a smooth experience. I’m not in the miniatures tabletop scene constantly, but I dabble with some casual games every now and then like Marvel United. The hardest part is finding a buddy or group willing to learn the complex game mechanics and dedicating time and space to matches. It’s been kind of a sore spot for me and my friends lately, always talking about wanting to play Warhammer 40K Kill Team , but never fully committing because we still want to properly build and paint. With Gundam Assemble, it’s easier to get games going because you only really need six mech units versus a multitude of grunts to fill up a squad or army on either side. Although there are still a lot of tokens for various effects and objectives, the most important feature that makes turn-taking smooth is the Gundam Assemble timeline. It consists of ten rounds equaling one phase. On the timeline, players have their mech units’ tokens slotted into specific spots to help track each unit’s turn. For example, the Gundam Vidar has a timeline start number of one compared to RX-78-2’s timeline start number two. This means that Gundam Vidar places its token on round one of the timeline at setup, signifying that it takes its turn first before moving to round two, where RX-78-2’s token sits. As units make certain actions, their unit token moves down the timeline. So depending on what your mech unit does, they could be waiting a long time to act again. Seeing which mech is next in line does give an extra layer of strategy similar to turn-based tactics video games like XCOM or Star Wars Zero Company . It’s nice to have the timeline set to the side of the map and away from the battlefield where token placements can get out of hand.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/06/gundamtimel-1793929700472.jpg

In a common scenario, players play through two phases or 20 rounds, trying to collect as many victory points as possible through various means. Scoring victory points ranges from rescuing/destroying garrisons to defeating a mech unit or holding objective points at the end of each phase. Each mech unit’s turn consists of a few possible options: advance, primary action, command abilities, and tactics cards. Advance is simply movement, and units can move up to three hexes in any direction. Although, when it comes to moving up a level of terrain, it costs two hexes of movement. There’s no terrain penalty going down a level, and units with a Hover ability ignore terrain penalties all together. Primary actions move the unit token down the timeline and includes options like attack, dash, energize, and rescue. Attacks on the unit cards have specific timeline costs. So if the RX-78-2’s Beam Saber attack has a timeline of three, the Gundam’s token moves down the timeline three rounds after using this specific attack. The other three primary actions normally cost two timeline rounds. Dash is an option to move two hexes further. In Char’s Zaku’s case, dashes can also deal damage with his Char Kick ability. Next is energize, which gives a unit an energy token so they can use certain abilities later in the game. And the last primary action is rescue, which can be used to rescue friendly garrison tokens on the battlefield for victory points. Some units benefit from rescuing garrisons like the RX-78-2, which has a command ability that increases its strength by one for every garrison rescued. Speaking of command abilities, that’s another option available during a mech unit’s turn that’s printed on the unit card. These command abilities usually have an energy cost and/or specific requirement, so plan accordingly. And finally there are tactics cards, which can be used up to once a turn before being discarded. Players start off with three tactics cards but eventually draw more after a phase ends. These are one-time use, ranging from repairing a mech unit to using an entirely new attack or countering an enemy unit. It seems like a lot for one turn, but at most times, players are mainly just advancing and using a primary action as options on the battlefield start to dwindle.

content.v: 消息称，古天乐可能首次进军内地网络剧市场，与导演马楚成合作一部由内地投资的警匪题材网络剧。目前该项目尚未官宣，项目名称、正式演员阵容及开机日期等信息也未公布。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261107/1794048112_319985_jpg_r.jpg
此次合作机会与《狩谎》的拍摄经历有关。古天乐早前曾客串这部由成毅主演的剧集，并与欧阳震华继1997年无线电视剧《美味天王》后再次同框。
《狩谎》拍摄期间，卫诗雅在片场发生意外并严重受伤，制作进度受阻，演员档期也受到影响。当时身在北京并担任监制的马楚成率领多名导演赴港协助，加快收尾工作，最终完成拍摄。古天乐与马楚成由此重新接触，并在交流各自工作计划时发现合作机会。
两人此前曾合作2007年电影《生日快乐》。若此次警匪网剧项目落实，将成为双方相隔约19年的再次合作。消息还称，马楚成希望为这部新制作争取更多在香港工作的机会，《狩谎》此前也曾争取赴港取景。

content.v: 驾驶出租车穿越满目疮痍的美国南部——这是一场生存之旅，你需要搜寻物资并修理你的汽车。《从零向南》现已在Steam上推出，并支持简体中文和日语。故事背景设定在受千年虫问题重创的美国，讲述了主人公一路向南，修复和加固一辆破旧汽车的旅程。

《从零向南》Steam国区原价35元，但为庆祝发售，11月21日前购买可享20%折扣，仅需28元
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261107/1794049102_850960_jpg_r.jpg
这款游戏设定在一个架空历史的美国，文明因“千年虫问题”（Y2K）而崩溃。玩家扮演一名出租车司机，踏上漫长的南方之旅。
旅程伊始，你的出租车伙伴破旧不堪，需要不断维护才能继续行驶。你还需要补充燃料和食物，因此沿途会停靠一些建筑物，搜寻补给、工具和零件。收集到的物品不仅可以用于维修，还可以用来升级车辆，例如提升性能或加装装甲。如果你的车抛锚或没油，没有人会来帮忙，所以如何利用有限的资源是生存的关键。
途中你可能会遇到武装匪帮，他们会封锁道路，伺机抢劫财物。想要继续前进，你必须击败他们，突破封锁。

content.v: 《魔兽世界：无限》的精髓在于让玩家放慢脚步，探索世界，而不是急于求成地冲向游戏后期。然而，尽管《无限》团队一直强调要玩家慢慢来，结交朋友，但已经有一位《魔兽世界：无限》玩家达到了60级。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261107/1794047933_536443.webp
由同名主播领衔的JokerD战队是首支达到60级的队伍，该战队全部由亡灵角色和一名巨魔组成。亡灵种族在此至关重要，因为暴雪修改了“吞噬”技能，使其能够帮助玩家回复法力值，这意味着玩家在进行大规模拉怪时几乎没有冷却时间。我花了一些时间观看这些速通玩家的直播，他们会聚集大批怪物，然后用AOE范围技能将其一举歼灭。
JokerD的成名是2019年《魔兽世界》 经典 怀旧服上线时成为全球首位达到60级的玩家，因此他的队伍在《魔兽世界：无限》中率先达到满级并不令人意外。虽然这次竞争异常激烈，但JokerD 的队伍始终遥遥领先。截至发稿时，排名第二且并非JokerD团队成员的 Ksuper Worldfirst仍然只有53级。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261107/1794047933_551898.webp
不过，虽然这些玩家已经达到满级很令人兴奋，但现在并没有太多理由急于进入游戏后期。首批团队副本——巴罗深渊、海加尔山峰和奥妮克希亚巢穴——要到12月9日才会开放，所以本周末达到等级上限的玩家可能会发现接下来该做什么。
我采访《魔兽世界：无限》首席游戏设计师克里斯·齐尔胡特时，他明确表示暴雪希望玩家练多个角色，并强调升级是游戏的重要组成部分。所以，如果你很早就升到了60级，但在团队副本开放前就玩腻了，那么不妨再练一个角色，走一条不同的升级路线。
《魔兽世界：无限》的上线也极其顺利，基本没有出现任何重大服务器问题。但是，暴雪后来宣称这款游戏使用了超过200TB的内存，所以如果服务器仍然因为玩家大量登录而崩溃，那就有点令人担忧了。
